# AssetPegasus

AssetPegasus is a cloud-based IT asset management software that helps organizations manage hardware assets, software licenses, warranties, maintenance schedules, insurance records, audits, and asset lifecycle from a centralized dashboard.

Website:
https://assetpegasus.com/

Product:
IT Asset Management Software

Key Features:
- IT Asset Tracking
- Software License Management
- Warranty Management
- Maintenance Scheduling
- Insurance Tracking
- Asset Audit Management
- Employee Asset Assignment
- Inventory Management
- QR Code & Barcode Support
- Reporting & Analytics
